references.text: Gibeon had made peace with Joshua and Israel, which is the background for why the five Amorite kings now want to attack Gibeon
The immediate context where King Adoni-Zedek of Jerusalem hears about the peace treaty and gathers the other four kings
Gibeon asks Joshua for help as a result of the attack by the five kings
The kings gathered against Israel, showing the pattern of coalitions forming against God's people
A similar situation where Adoni-Bezek and Canaanite kings cooperate against Israel
A psalm describing enemies gathering against God's people and planning to wipe them out
An earlier example of a coalition of kings joining together for war
